name: free-uk-data-removal-tool
description: Ask UK data brokers to erase your personal data under UK GDPR, sending every request from your own email.

interface.shortDescription: Get off UK data broker lists
interface.longDescription: Help for anyone in the UK who wants their details off the lists that companies buy and sell. The plugin gives your assistant a checked list of UK data brokers, people-search sites and marketing list sellers, with each company's privacy email or form taken from its own privacy page, and a UK GDPR erasure and objection letter to send from your own email. It also covers opting out of the open electoral register, the Telephone and Mailing Preference Services, a one-month chase-up letter and how to complain to the Information Commissioner's Office. The plugin is never sent your personal details: its tools take none, and your assistant fills in the letter inside your own conversation. It never asks for a date of birth or ID. It is not legal advice, and it cannot delete data already leaked to criminals.
capabilities: List UK data brokers to contact
Opt out of the open electoral register
